data.name: Sarup
data.gender_notes: Sarup is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sarup is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sarupa', which means 'golden' or 'radiant'. This name is often given to babies born during the festival of Diwali, the Hindu festival of lights. Sarup is a name that signifies purity, radiance, and the triumph of light over darkness. The name Sarup carries the meaning “Golden, Radiant, Pure” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sarup usually hope their child will grow to embody golden, radiant, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sarup is a name that resonates with the spiritual qualities of purity, radiance, and light. It is a name that reminds us of the divine light that exists within each of us and encourages us to shine brightly in the world.
data.etymology: Sarup belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Golden, Radiant, Pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sarup total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
